family_availability_law.shape_mapping: UNAVAILABLE; not loaded and not proxied
family_availability_law.pinnacle: UNAVAILABLE; not loaded and not proxied

sibling_response_contract.arming_event: first positive-size fill on the first-filled leg
sibling_response_contract.activation_event: sibling's own strictly later receipt-identifiable positive-size flow or divot trigger after its own independent presence
sibling_response_contract.guard_law: maker ceiling, exact +1, positive price band, par, maximum-cost, and one-price-authority guards all pass
sibling_response_contract.missing_evidence: NO_CALL_UNAVAILABLE; underlying sibling order remains independently managed and the event is not censored solely by response abstention

recut_contract.cell_updates: causal BBO updates may update the latent cell without cancelling an order
recut_contract.order_change: a recut may change an order only on a later receipt-identifiable positive-size divot or recognized causal checkpoint
recut_contract.queue_law: unchanged evidence means hold the current order and preserve queue position
